title: Delivery Man

experience: Previous experience in a similar role as a Delivery Driver is preferred
description_text:
Our client is a well-established company operating within the electrical and engineering sector, providing high-quality services and solutions across various projects in Malta. They are currently seeking a reliable and motivated Delivery Driver to join their team.
 Position Summary
 The Delivery Driver is responsible for the safe and timely transportation of materials, tools, and equipment to various project sites and client locations across Malta. The role also involves loading and unloading goods, maintaining delivery records, and ensuring company vehicles are operated safely and efficiently.
 Key Responsibilities
 Deliver a wide range of materials and equipment to various locations and project sites.
 Load, unload, prepare, inspect, and operate company delivery vehicles safely.
 Ensure all deliveries are completed accurately and on time.
 Complete delivery logs, reports, and any required documentation.
 Conduct basic vehicle checks and report any maintenance issues promptly.
 Adhere to all company policies, road safety regulations, and health and safety procedures.
 Assist with warehouse and store duties when required.
 Maintain a professional and courteous attitude when dealing with clients and colleagues.
 Requirements
 Previous experience in a similar role as a Delivery Driver is preferred.
 Valid driving licence Category C or C1 is mandatory.
 Ability to operate a forklift will be considered an asset.
 Good knowledge of Maltese roads and traffic regulations.
 Strong organisational and time management skills.
 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
 Clean driving record with no major traffic violations.
 Reliable, responsible, and able to work independently.
 What We Offer
 Stable full-time employment with an indefinite contract.
 Opportunity to join a reputable and growing company.
 Supportive working environment and team culture.
 Career development opportunities.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you are a dependable and safety-conscious driver looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and become part of a dynamic and professional team.
